entries.props: Propositions (metavariable P) represent statements, which can perhaps be proven.

entries.implication-former: P -> P is the implication former
entries.implication-intro: x => p is the implication introduction form
entries.implication-elim: p(p) is the implication elimination form

entries.conjunction-former: P & P is the conjunction former
entries.conjunction-intro: (p, p) is the conjunction introduction form
entries.conjunction-elim: p.fst and p.snd are the conjunction elimination forms
